description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BuildingHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsOrder" name="Materials order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the tree house"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Tree house party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect" processRef="Process_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineStores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialRequirements" name="Initial requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="StartEvent_Architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdatedRequirements" name="Additional requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdatedRequirements" targetRef="StartEvent_Architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Draft" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MaterialsOrder" name="Materials order" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_OnlineStores" messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the tree house" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Tree house party invitation" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_You" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to the architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine the draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreRequirements" name="More requirements to add?" default="Flow_NoMoreRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdatedRequirements" name="Send additional requirements to the architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from the plan"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CategorizeMaterials" name="Categorize materials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from several online stores" messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkSplit" name="Wait for order processing and contact friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitForOrderProcessing" name="Wait for materials order to be processed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Send messages to friends to build the house" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin" name="Order processing and messages complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the tree house"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations to friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_You" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_You" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_5" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Gateway_MoreRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesMoreRequirements" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendUpdatedRequirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreRequirements}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoMoreRequirements" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRequirements" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_8" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdatedRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_9" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_10" sourceRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_11" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_12" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitForOrderProcessing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_14" sourceRef="Task_WaitForOrderProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_15" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_17" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_18" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_19" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="EndEvent_You"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Architect" name="Architect prepares a draft" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Architect" name="Requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Requirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDraft" name="Prepare a draft"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Architect" name="Draft sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Architect" targetRef="Task_PrepareDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDraft" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_3" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="EndEvent_Architect"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
